reason: The monoclinic cell is strongly supported and Z=2 is plausible, but exact recovery is not sufficiently established. No comparable whole-pattern Rwp is available; the trajectory optimized a custom extracted sqrt-intensity objective only over 5-55 degrees rather than validating the full 5-90 degree profile, and several materially different P1 heavy-atom minima had nearly indistinguishable scores. The P1 symmetry breaking is therefore not decisive, while the boron coordinates were chosen largely from imposed B-B/B-Ir geometry in an Ir-dominated Cu X-ray pattern rather than independently determined. Occupancy/disorder and other symmetry or framework alternatives were not adequately compared, so another scientifically motivated solution/refinement attempt could materially improve the candidate set.
